correctness.rationale: Root separation makes the (1,2) system base-point-free; ampleness gives finiteness, self-intersection four and the degree-one/two relation rank tests give a birational quartic. The two ruling columns at each parameter have rank two. Off the diagonal any rank drop below three on the intersection determinant would make the residual curve singular; thus each pair gives a unique point, and at a simple diagonal root the divided-difference rank gives the unique critical source point on that ruling. The smooth (2,2) residual curve D has genus one and four simple exchange-fixed points. For clarity on the conductor step: the incidence map from D to the normalization extends across the diagonal; transverse plane nodes with two distinct source points give two immersed transverse surface branches (the coordinate plane cuts each source branch smoothly). This supplies generic double rather than triple fibers along the integral incidence image. Off that image fibers have one immersed point, hence are normal. The image in the normalization is therefore the reduced conductor divisor (multiplicity one by the generic double germ), of class (2,2) by finite duality for the quartic. It has arithmetic genus one and normalization D of genus one, hence is itself smooth. Its image B has degree three by the degree-two conductor map and the (1,2) intersection; the exact rank-four witness makes it a twisted cubic. The conductor gluing along the étale parts gives two transverse branches; at the simple branch points the completed ring is C[[u,t^2,ut]], the ordinary pinch. On each plane the conic and two ruling lines give five transverse nodes, two with a single source point at a product of local parameters and three with two sources. The latter exhaust the cubic's three intersections with the plane. Root separation alone would not establish avoidance of all other planes; the independent good-reduction check proves that each pair of planes cuts four distinct image points at the witness, an additional open condition. This verifies the distinct 8+12 split rather than just the section counts with multiplicities.
residual_risks: The incidence curve means the closure of the ordered pairs of distinct intersecting rulings; the raw determinant also contains the doubled diagonal. All conclusions are for a nonempty open family over C, not for degenerations.

value.rationale: The coordinate boundary is distinguished by the product itself. Its twenty nodes separate two genuinely different ways that a plane section can fail to be transverse, useful for studying the product at the toric boundary or under degeneration.
